role: Independent native Codex whole-candidate reviewer; no author edits
scope: Additive opt-in projection/2.0.0 local contract, guards, pure reference selectors, generated declarations and focused acceptance tests. Approval is a source/semantic review of this exact candidate, not main integration or production acceptance.
review_basis: Exact schema and normative contract bytes are the previously reviewed and approved pair. Installed freeze manifest is the independently approved byte-for-byte manifest; protected test pins its literal hash and exact two-file inventory and hashes the actual bodies.

Descriptor preflight runs before canonicalization or cloning; accessor/non-data containers, cycles, bare proxies, non-JSON values and bounded-resource violations are refused. Detached validated inputs are used and returned output is deeply frozen. No arbitrary host-code isolation guarantee is asserted.

Context guards bind full scope, requested actor/party, supplied authenticated principal and supplied policy to the exact checkpoint. Query time bounds include explicit genesis_world_time. Canonical queries require the specified system privilege.

Actor selection validates supplied rows including filtered rows, enforces acquisition cutoffs and references, deterministically deduplicates, strips private provenance and conservatively withholds claims under current policy cutoffs.
Canonical relation selection uses half-open valid-time and recorded-sequence intervals, rejects ambiguous selected revisions and preserves historical prefix behavior.
Sorted bounded ID tuple arrays avoid arbitrary Iterable execution and preserve permitted scalar identifiers. Generator emits structural declarations from actual schema and --check is read-only.
v1 public exports are changed only by additive re-exports. All four frozen v1 bodies and their existing freeze manifest remain byte-identical to baseline.
Final test/fixture/generator hashes exactly match research_r3 separate policy approval. Their trust promotion remains an explicit supervisor/controller action.

focused_tests.context: Offline native Node execution with authorized require_escalated to permit native test IPC

projection_generator_check.note: Run independently in earlier review and again within passing focused generated-declarations test; generator bytes unchanged.

root_reported_checks_not_rerun_here: Absent-module RED before implementation retained at /tmp/argo-pc-red.log
limits: Pure local guards/selectors only: no persistent two-plane store, bus, service, transactional projector, crash recovery or deployed adapter is implemented or proven.

Trusted host must supply authenticated principal, current policy and release ordering, verified checkpoint ancestry/genesis, and verified source-event-to-row correspondence. Local consistency checks do not authenticate source rows or prove entitlement freshness or rollback resistance.
Public v2 actor claims are deliberately empty at current cutoff; v1 behavior is unchanged and callers opt in explicitly. The v2 genesis lower bound is also an explicit opt-in semantic constraint.
28 focused executable tests are not proof that the earlier 111 declarative design cases or 10000-event replay workload have run or passed.

Existing controller completion checks do not isolate arbitrary hostile same-interpreter runtime/protocol tampering. New test/fixture/generator trust policy needs supervisor adoption outside candidate control.

Board data-gate success is staging acceptance only. Exact candidate and trusted policy must pass all ten application-controller groups before main integration; this review does not implement or approve a general board application adapter.
R06/R10/R12/R13 and production authority/history/provider obligations remain deferred.
remaining_acceptance: Supervisor adopts exact separately reviewed policy bytes into immutable trusted checkout
